own_memberships.name: own_memberships
own_memberships.using: nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid IS NULL AND "memberships"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid

payments_one_document.name: payments_one_document
payments_one_document.value: ("payments"."kind" = 'invoice_receipt' AND "payments"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."bill_id" IS NULL) OR ("payments"."kind" = 'bill_payment' AND "payments"."bill_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."invoice_id" IS NULL)

tenant_access.name: tenant_access
tenant_access.using: "tenants"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid OR (nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid IS NULL AND "tenants"."id" IN (SELECT m.tenant_id FROM memberships m WHERE m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid))
